megan: Heads-up — need a compact one-pager for field + SDRs: combine deploy-mode messaging, SLA callouts, and a short benchmark nugget for enterprise security buyers.
jamal: Make it reusable as a launch email blurb, webinar promo visual, and sales leave-behind.
luis: One front/back sheet: side A value props + deploy matrix, side B technical quick facts + inbound routing rules.
anna: Field asks: 1) security bullets for compliance, 2) SLA summary for procurement, 3) deploy-mode hint for platform leads.
megan: Target audiences: CISO, Platform/DevOps, Procurement. Keep copy short.
jamal: Draft structure: top-line positioning + 3-row matrix (Hosted/Dedicated/Private); middle security callouts (KMS, VPC, HSM, audit logs); right column SLA snapshot (uptime, latency SLOs, escalation path); bottom benchmark (p95 latency, cost delta); footer CTA + routing tag.
luis: Benchmark nugget suggestion: "P95 latency 120–220ms at 95% utilization on typical chat workloads using dedicated pools."
anna: Suggested inbound labels: deploy_interest:hosted|dedicated|private, compliance_need:high|medium|low, sla:standard|enterprise.
megan: Include 2-line sellers' scripts for discovery.
jamal: Scripts: Platform: "Which constraints matter most—isolation, throughput, or data residency? We recommend Dedicated for sustained throughput, Private for residency/compliance." Security: "We integrate with customer KMS/HSM and provide audit trails + optional on-prem agents for air-gapped ops."
luis: Micro-FAQ: "What if capacity constrained? -> automatic routing to compatible model variant with no client code changes."
anna: Timeline: design draft Tue EOD, final copy Thu for webinar/email prep.
megan: Owners: copy=jamal, benchmarks=luis, field validation=anna, design=@design-team. I'll own distribution.
jamal: Suggested short email subjects: "Enterprise-grade inference: pick the right deployment for security & SLAs"; "Reduce inference latency and meet compliance needs — how teams choose deployment."
luis: Quick-facts (micro): Throughput: Dedicated -> <100ms median token time at 8k windows; Caching: prefix/KV reduces token cost ~30% on repeats; Fallbacks: automatic model-variant routing keeps ops <1% error rate.
anna: Distribution checklist: publish to field portal, add CTAs in trial onboarding, email blast to enterprise segment, webinar promo with benchmark demo + Q&A.
megan: Inbound routing snippet for ops: if deploy_interest == "private" OR compliance_need == "high": tag -> enterprise-sales; elif sla == "enterprise": tag -> enterprise-sales; else: tag -> growth-team.
jamal: 10-word elevator pitch: "Predictable, secure LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments."
luis: Legal blurb: "Benchmark figures from internal Redwood labs; results may vary by workload."
anna: I'll gather 1–2 field quotes for the sheet.
megan: Next steps: jamal final copy by Wed noon; luis confirm benchmarks by Wed 5pm; anna field quotes by Thu EOD; design mock Wed afternoon.
jamal: Will post final copy here when ready. Please react :thumbsup: on routing snippet.
luis: :thumbsup:
